BiblicalUsage: zâmâm means a plot. In Psalms 140:8 we read, "Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves."
TheologicalSignificance: zamam is a plot, and I hold that God teaches through ordinary words as well as great ones.
